0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The hanuman langur is beckoning to you with uncertain intent.

24.original: Speak with the strange hanuman langur and follow behind it.

50.original: It appears this creature wants you to follow it. What harm could come from doing so?

52.original: The creature appears to want you to follow it deeper into the jungle.

53.original: Follow the hanuman langur and try not to fall behind.

56.original: The creature has guided you to this elderly Auri woman, but you have yet to discern why. However, it is plain that she requires aid.

57.original: You come upon an elderly Auri woman, bent over in pain and breathing haggardly. Provide what treatment to her that you can.

58.original: Thank...thank you. I feel much better now.

59.original: A terrible beast fell upon me, and I fled, quickly losing my bearings in the thick woods. This kindly creature guided me to safety, but my wounds pained me.

60.original: How long ago was that? Bells ago? Days ago? I cannot say...

62.original: Of course, little friend. Thank you for delivering this kind soul to me. I owe you my life.

64.original: We shouldn't stay here, for nowhere outside the village gates is safe. I believe I can return safely on my own. Seek me out, and I shall see you are rewarded for what you've done.

65.original: Ah, my savior arrives at last! I feel right as rain now, and all thanks to your ministrations.

66.original: And that creature, of course. I haven't seen it since returning here...

67.original: The legends of this island say the hanuman langurs are servants of the divinities, appearing when they deign to show an interest in worldly affairs. I think there may be some truth to those tales.

68.original: I must remember to make an offering when I am able. As for <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> reward, however, please take this, and know that I shall never forget the goodwill you showed me.
